set.body:
Plan: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: O04
Accountable role (person not assigned): Backend engineer with institutional data steward

Outcome: Withdrawal and any required erasure have explicit effects on current service and restored copies.

Acceptance:
- Implement durable quarantine/withdrawal controls and journal them independently; define current delivery, linked views, pending operations and derivative obligations without inferring permissions from provenance.
- Document institution-specific retention, backup expiry, shared-blob reachability and any required physical-erasure procedure; keep automatic collection disabled unless separately qualified.
- Back up, then withdraw/restrict data, lose the original host and restore: restricted content remains unavailable. Required erasure or source-evidence obligations that lack a qualified procedure block admission of affected data.

Evidence anchors:
- docs/prd.md
- modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/PostgresRecovery.scala

Status: planned; no implementation or qualification claimed.
set.title: O04: Enforce quarantine, withdrawal and recovery lifecycle policy
